verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voting for the Top 20 begins on March 16, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'On the March 16th episode'; R3: 'begins at the start of the East Coast broadcast of “American Idol” on March 16'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported by dates in R2 and R3 for Top 20 voting start.

verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voting features social media voting.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'through social media'; R2: 'vote on social media'; R3: 'vote ... via social media'; R4: 'on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly mention social media as a voting method.

verifications.claim: Fans can vote up to 10 times per contestant per method on AmericanIdol.com/Vote, text, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'up to 10 times per method, per platform'; R2: '10 votes per artist per method'; R3: 'up to 10 votes per voting method per contestant'; lists specific platforms/methods
verifications.reasoning: References confirm 10 votes per method/platform across website, text, and individual social platforms (FB, IG, TT).

verifications.claim: Up to 50 votes total per user for American Idol 2026 voting.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'a total of 50 votes'; R2: 'adds up to 50 possible votes'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated total in R1 and R2.

verifications.claim: Online voting for American Idol 2026 is at AmericanIdol.com/Vote.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Social media voting for American Idol 2026 is at @AmericanIdol on Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '@AmericanIdol on Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok'; R2: 'Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok'; R3: 'official “American Idol” page on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok'

verifications.claim: Social media voting for American Idol 2026 requires finding the pinned "Official Vote Post" and commenting the first name of the artist.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'find the pinned post, and comment the first name'; R3: 'comment on the pinned official voting post with the name'; R4: 'Commenting on the pinned official voting post'

verifications.claim: Text voting for American Idol 2026 is by sending text messages to 21523.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Text/SMS ... to 21523'; R2: 'Text 1 to 21523'; R3: 'texted to “21523.”'

verifications.claim: Specific voting lines for American Idol 2026 contestants are announced during the show.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'During each “Idol” episode, a contestant will have a specific number'; R2 lists specific texts like 'Text 1 to 21523'
verifications.reasoning: R3 explicitly states announcement during show; R2 provides examples.

verifications.claim: Users can cast up to 10 votes per artist on each of the three platforms (website, text, social media) for American Idol 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: '10 times per method, per platform — a total of 50 votes' (implies 5: website, text, FB, IG, TT); R2: '10 ... per method ... 50 possible'
verifications.reasoning: Claim specifies three platforms (implying 30 votes max), but references state 50 votes with social media as three separate platforms.

verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voters must be 16 or older.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R4: '16 years of age or older' for website; 'at least 18 years old' for social media
verifications.reasoning: Supported for online voting but higher age (18+) required for social media; not uniform across methods.

verifications.claim: American Idol 2026 voters must be located in the U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R4: 'U.S., Puerto Rico, or the Virgin Islands' for website; 'located in the U.S.' for social media
verifications.reasoning: Fully supported for online but social specifies only U.S., potentially excluding PR/VI.

verifications.evidence: R3: 'start of the East Coast broadcast ... on March 16'; R2: 'March 16th episode'
